description: Three independent changed-case checks for the revised worked PCP exposition
execution_kind: Exact finite computation with ordinary mathematical derivations recorded separately

cases.name: request_dependent_mask
cases.label_space: F_2^8: coefficient labels of squarefree degree-at-most-three polynomials in three bits
cases.received_word: Flip only label 0 in the honest evaluation word

coupled_request_and_mask.experiment: U uniform; Lambda=U; R=U; output g(R)+g(R+Lambda)

cases.ordinary_derivation: For Lambda=R=U!=0, g(U)+g(0)=h(U)+1; for U=0 both errors cancel. With a fixed nonzero Lambda and fresh R, exactly R=0 or R=Lambda contributes one corruption.
cases.lesson: Marginal uniformity of R does not replace uniformity conditional on the request. The two actual reads need not be independent.

cases.name: arbitrary_inner_polynomial

ordinary_root_bound_deduction.claim: No polynomial of degree <9 has the same function as Y^12 on F_16
ordinary_root_bound_deduction.method: For any such p, Y^12-p is nonzero of degree 12 and therefore has at most 12 roots; function equality would require 16 roots.

cases.lesson: An inner degree-c guarantee does not imply the honest univariate capacity bound. The arbitrary decoded polynomial needs the enlarged substitution degree bound.
cases.scope: This is a degree/representation changed case, not a complete PCP parameter instance.

cases.name: bad_auxiliary_anchor_fibre
cases.oriented_row_index: (anchor a, direction v), with both in F_Q^k; zero direction included
cases.bad_rows: Every row whose anchor is the prescribed a*, regardless of its direction
cases.ordinary_derivation: There are Q^(2k) pairs (a,v), and Q^k bad pairs with a=a*. Their fraction is Q^(-k). Conditioning on the fixed target a* leaves only those Q^k bad rows, so the bad fraction is 1.
cases.lesson: A global auxiliary-row average alone cannot control a prescribed target. The actual corrector rejection term is essential to the target-specific guarantee.
cases.scope: Exact row-index counting. No field arithmetic, inner-test rejection rate, or complete cheating PCP is asserted.

limitations: No Lean elaboration, kernel replay, or axiom extraction was performed.
No small-field example is claimed to satisfy the full PCP parameter regime.
Successful model calculations are not measured human-learning outcomes.
The no-low-degree-representative conclusion uses the ordinary root bound, not exhaustive enumeration of polynomials.
